effect_description_eng:
＜Decoy ([Xros Heart] trait)＞ (When your other [Xros Heart] trait Digimon would be deleted by an opponent's effect, you may delete this Digimon to prevent 1 of those Digimon's deletion.)
[On Deletion] You may play 1 [ShootingStarmon] from under your Tamers without paying the cost. Then, place 1 [Starmons] and 1 [Pickmons] from your trash as that Digimon's bottom digivolution cards.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has the [Xros Heart] trait, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.
